inputs.spec_clause_ref: kerml clause 8.2.5.13 (PackagesConcreteSyntax.md, region_sha256 2f4d82cdd704641c) | sysml clause 8.2.2.5.1 (Packages.md, region_sha256 3ee603b1b89d4345)
inputs.xtext_rule_text:
ElementFilterMember returns SysML::ElementFilterMembership :
	MemberPrefix
	'filter' ownedRelatedElement += OwnedExpression ';'
;

decision: A member prefix, `filter`, the condition, and a semicolon. The condition is an OwnedExpression, which is why this production could not be derived until the expression layer was.
notes: The two languages assign the expression differently: SysML 8.2.2.5.1 writes 'ownedRelatedElement += OwnedExpression' and KerML 8.2.5.13 writes 'condition = OwnedExpression'. Nothing about what parses turns on that — the text is the same either way — and the difference is in which abstract-syntax slot the expression lands in. Recorded here rather than resolved, because this production is concrete syntax and the assignment belongs to whoever builds the element.
